:::{#exr-bernoulli-mle}
#### Maximum likelihood estimate of a binary sample

In the setting of @exr-bernoulli-score-equation,
use @thm-bernoulli-hessian-nd to find the [maximum likelihood estimate](#def-mle) $\hprob_{\text{ML}}$ of $\prob$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-bernoulli-mle}

By @thm-bernoulli-hessian-nd, $\llik$ is strictly concave on $(0, 1)$.
A strictly concave [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/functions.html#def-function) that has a [critical point](#def-critical-point) is maximized there, and nowhere else.
With $\outbar \in (0, 1)$, @thm-bernoulli-score-equation says the only critical point of $\llik$ in $(0, 1)$ is $\outbar$.
So $\llik$ is maximized at $\prob = \outbar$.

:::
